lemmas.primary_translation: used to express that something mentioned is untrue, does not deserve its characterization, or the like

definitions.text: brukt for å uttrykke at noe som er omtalt, ikke stemmer, ikke fortjener sin karakteristikk eller lignende
definitions.translation: used to express that something mentioned is untrue, does not deserve its characterization, or the like (lit. sure, I said butter!)

examples.no: det skulle bli en solfylt og deilig søndag. Jommen sa jeg smør!
examples.en: It was supposed to be a sunny and lovely Sunday. Yeah, right!

examples.no: virker det ikke ganske enkelt? Enkelt!? Jammen sa jeg smør!
examples.en: Doesn't it seem quite easy? Easy!? Yeah, right!

examples.no: møtet skulle ikke vare lenger enn en time. Jaggu sa jeg smør.
examples.en: The meeting was not supposed to last more than an hour. Yeah, right!
